Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the form. Quick answers up front, plus a short guidance pack below.

1) Audit period: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (report issued 2026-02-15). If you need coverage overlapping 2026, we can provide a bridge letter that states no material changes through the requested window and points to our controls and change log.

2) Bridge letter: Yes — we provide a standard bridge letter (signed by our Head of Security) and can add scoped language if you need a specific cutoff. Typical turnaround: 3–5 business days.

3) Transfer options: secure SFTP or pre-signed S3 links are preferred. We can support short-lived Drive links for lower-sensitivity reviews but will usually redact certain operational details from shared artifacts.

Attached below are: a one-page REDACTION GUIDANCE we use, an SFTP instructions stub, and two short reply templates you can use when routing the ask internally.

Minimal artifacts we commonly share (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if requested)
- Control summaries (policy snapshots) — often redacted
- Audited exceptions & remediation summaries (if applicable)

If you want a minimal set for procurement only, reply ACK and we'll initiate SFTP transfer with a pre-signed link and the bridge letter draft. If you need the full package (report + control snapshots + evidence samples), let me know and we'll open an evidence share folder and arrange redaction as needed.

Quick templates (copy/paste):
- Procurement-only ACK: "ACK. Please share the SOC 2 Type II PDF + bridge letter via SFTP."
- Full package request: "Please provision the SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and supporting control snapshots (1) via SFTP, and (2) include the redaction guidance."

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
